title: Dropping Legacy Column During Rolling Deployment (Negative Hazard)

context_files.db_migration_policy.md:
# Engineering Policy: Zero-Downtime Database Migrations

- Rule 1 (Expand-Contract Mandatory): Schema modifications involving column drops or rename operations are strictly backward-incompatible.
- Rule 2 (Prerequisite Condition): A `DROP COLUMN` migration must NEVER be executed against production while any active replica/pod is serving traffic with an older application version that queries that column.
- Rule 3: 100% of serving pods must be running the new version with zero metric reads to the deprecated column for at least 24 hours prior to column deletion.
